faqs.q: Where can I buy an energy-saving jiko in Kenya?
faqs.a: Order it from Kitchen And All on kitchenandall.co.ke, or talk to our team for advice first. Delivery is free within Nairobi and quick to the rest of Kenya with shipping charges.

faqs.q: Are these good energy saving jikos for schools?
faqs.a: Yes. They are built for school kitchens, with insulation and chimneys that cut firewood use and keep smoke out of the kitchen.

faqs.q: How much fuel can I save using this jiko?
faqs.a: Energy-Saving Jikos reduce fuel consumption by up to 70%, lowering your operational costs significantly.

faqs.q: What size jiko should I choose for my institution?
faqs.a: Sizes range from 50L to 500L. For example, a 100L jiko can serve up to 150 people per meal. Choose based on your average meal volume.

faqs.q: Can I use different types of fuel with this jiko?
faqs.a: Yes, it works efficiently with charcoal, firewood, and briquettes, providing flexibility depending on fuel availability.

faqs.q: Is maintenance difficult?
faqs.a: No, cleaning ashes regularly and checking chimney ventilation keeps the jiko running safely and efficiently.
